items.description: World generation: initWorld produces a 420x240 tile grid with surface terrain, caves, ores, trees, and spawn point.
Player physics: gravity, collision, movement (A/D), jumping (Space), platform drop-through (S+Space).
Block interaction: left-click breaks tiles with pickaxe/axe, right-click places blocks, hand-breaking works on soft tiles.
Enemy spawning and AI: slimes hop, zombies walk, flyers hover. Spawn rate varies by depth and day/night.
Combat: sword swing damages enemies, enemies deal contact damage, player death drops coins and respawns.
Day/night cycle: sky color transitions, sun/moon rendering, stars at night, enemy spawn rate changes at night.
Inventory: 50-slot inventory, 10-slot hotbar with number-key/scroll selection, item stacking, block placement from inventory.
Crafting: 33 recipes (tools, weapons, armor, potions, stations). E key opens crafting UI, filters by nearby stations.
Rendering: Camera follows player with smoothing, tiles render with colors, enemies have distinct shapes, HUD shows HP/hotbar/time/coins.
Deliverable: index.html is a self-contained single-file HTML+Canvas+JS game with no external dependencies, playable in any modern browser.
